words.ex_cn: 我记得我离开前锁了门。

words.tr: phrase. 报告某事；举报某事
words.ex: You should report the incident to the police.
words.ex_cn: 你应该向警方报告这件事。

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: v. 与某人分享某物；和某人共用某物
words.ex: He shares his lunch with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友分享他的午餐。
words.en: To use, have, or experience something jointly with another person or people.

words.tr: v. 把某物给某人看；向某人展示某物
words.en: To display or present something to someone.

words.tr: v. 给某人看某物；向某人展示某物
words.en: To display or present an object to another person.

words.ex: The factory will shut down next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂下个月将关闭。
words.en: To close something, especially a business or machine, so that it stops operating.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: phrase. 花费时间；度过时光
words.ex: I like to spend time with my family on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在周末和家人共度时光。
words.en: To use time to do something or stay in a place.

words.tr: phrase. 忍受做某事（通常用于否定句或疑问句，表示无法容忍某种行为）
words.ex: I can't stand waiting in long lines.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受排长队。
words.en: To tolerate or endure a situation, action, or person without becoming upset or angry.

words.ex: He starts doing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To begin an activity or process.

words.ex: He starts to eat breakfast at seven.
words.ex_cn: 他七点开始吃早餐。
words.en: To begin to do something; to take the first step in doing something.

words.ex: She will stay in the room.
words.ex_cn: 她将待在房间里。

words.tr: phrase. 走进；介入；开始参与（某事）
words.ex: He steps into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地走进房间。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a situation or role.

words.uk: stɒp ɛs biː frɒm ˈdʊɪŋ ɛs əθ
words.us: stɑːp ɛs biː frɒm ˈduːɪŋ ɛs əθ
words.en: To prevent someone from performing an action.

words.tr: phrase. 成功做某事；在做某事上取得成功
words.ex: He will succeed in doing his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他会成功地按时完成作业。
words.en: To achieve a desired outcome or goal through effort.

words.ex: He suggests going for a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他建议晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To propose an action or idea for consideration.

words.tr: 表示应该做某事，被期望做某事，通常指根据规则、义务或常理应当完成的动作
words.ex: You are supposed to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: used to say what someone should or should not do, especially because of rules or what someone in authority has said

words.tr: phrase. 使某人惊讶；给某人带来惊喜
words.ex: I want to surprise my friend on her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我想在我的朋友生日那天给她一个惊喜。

words.tr: phrase. 使某人措手不及；出其不意地袭击或惊吓某人
words.ex: His sudden resignation took everyone by surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他突然辞职让所有人都大吃一惊。
words.en: To cause someone to feel surprise because they were not expecting something.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.ex: I talk with my friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天和我的朋友聊天。
words.en: To have a conversation with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人交谈；跟某人说话
words.ex: I talk to my friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天和我的朋友聊天。
words.en: Speak to someone, often for a conversation or discussion.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细考虑；重新考虑
words.ex: I need time to think over your offer.
words.ex_cn: 我需要时间考虑你的提议。
words.en: To consider carefully before making a decision.

words.w: try one's best to do sth
words.tr: 短语动词。尽某人最大努力做某事
words.ex: He tries his best to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他尽力完成他的作业。
words.en: To make a maximum effort to accomplish something.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.tr: 用于做某事，表示某物被用来做某事，通常指用途或功能
words.ex: This tool is used to cut wood.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具被用来切割木头。
words.en: To have a particular function or purpose; to be employed for a specific task.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: I want to visit sp.
words.ex_cn: 我想参观sp。

words.tr: phrase. 提高嗓门；大声说话；因生气或激动而提高音量
words.ex: He raises his voice when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会提高嗓门。
words.en: to speak louder

words.ex: Please wait for me.
words.ex_cn: 请等我。

words.ex: He takes a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去散步；去走一走
words.ex: He goes for a walk after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后去散步。
words.en: To go for a walk means to leave your home or workplace in order to walk somewhere, usually for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: I want to do my homework now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在想做作业。
words.en: To have a desire or intention to perform a specific action or task.

words.tr: v. 警告某人某事；提醒某人注意某事
words.ex: The teacher warned the students of the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师提醒学生们注意考试。
words.en: to inform someone about a potential danger or problem

words.ex: It is important to wash one's face every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天洗脸很重要。

words.tr: phrase. 看见某人正在做某事
phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.ex: He is worried about his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他担心他的数学考试。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about someone or something.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没去上学。
words.en: If someone is absent from a place where they are usually found or where they are expected to be, they are not there.

words.ex: He will apologize to her tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会向她道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.ex: He made an apology to her for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到向她道歉。

words.tr: 动词短语. 与某人争论；和某人争吵
words.ex: He often argues with his brother about TV time.
words.ex_cn: 他经常和弟弟为看电视的时间争吵。
words.en: To engage in a verbal dispute or disagreement with another person.

words.ex: I know for certain that he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他会来。
words.en: If you know something for certain, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: He works at a chain store near his house.
words.ex_cn: 他在家附近的连锁店工作。
words.en: A chain store is one of a series of shops owned by one company and selling the same type of goods.

words.ex: He changed his mind and decided to go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了主意，决定去参加派对。
words.en: If you change your mind, you make a different decision or have a different opinion from the one you had before.

words.tr: 短语动词. 在考试中作弊
words.ex: He tried to cheat in the exam by looking at his friend's paper.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过看朋友的试卷在考试中作弊。
words.en: To act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a test or examination.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. v. 仔细检查；彻底查看
words.ex: She decided to check over the report one last time before submitting it.
words.ex_cn: 她在提交报告前决定再仔细检查一遍。
words.en: To examine something carefully in order to find mistakes or problems.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: I will contact you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会联系你。

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.ex: She covers the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 她用一块布覆盖桌子。

words.tr: phrase. 着迷的；狂热的；热衷于
words.ex: He is crazy about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他酷爱打篮球。
words.en: To be extremely enthusiastic or passionate about something.

words.ex: He is curious about how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他对植物如何生长感到好奇。
words.en: To have a strong desire to learn or know about something.

words.ex: He dares to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他敢在全班面前讲话。
words.en: To have the courage or boldness to do something.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.ex: The wind scattered the leaves in all directions.
words.ex_cn: adv. 风把树叶吹得四散。
words.en: In every direction; everywhere around.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate something into parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is without doubt the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is definitely true or will definitely happen

words.tr: 短语动词. 梦想做某事；渴望实现某事
words.ex: He dreams of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想成为一名医生。
words.en: To have a strong desire or aspiration to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿衣服；着装
words.ex: He gets dressed at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点穿衣服。
words.en: To put on clothes.

words.ex: He works at a store to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店工作赚钱。
words.en: To receive money as payment for work or services performed.

words.ex: Smoking has an effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对健康有影响。
words.en: To cause a change or influence something.

words.w: make an effort to do sth
words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；尽力去做某事
words.ex: He makes an effort to go to school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力按时上学。
words.en: To try hard to do something, especially when it is difficult or requires a lot of work.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.ex: The boy tried to escape from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩试图从着火的房子里逃出来。
words.en: To get away from a place or a situation that is dangerous, unpleasant, or difficult.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: He takes exercise every morning in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园里锻炼。
words.en: To perform physical activities in order to stay healthy and improve physical fitness.

words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做运动来保持健康。
words.en: To perform physical activity to maintain or improve health and fitness.

words.ex: I expect to finish the report by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我期望在周五前完成报告。

words.ex: Please explain clearly what you mean.
words.ex_cn: 请清楚地解释你的意思。

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.uk: fɔːs ɛs biː tuː dʊ ɛs ʌθ
words.us: fɔːrs ɛs biː tuː dʊ ɛs θ
words.en: To compel someone to undertake a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 新鲜空气；清新的空气
words.ex: He likes to breathe fresh air in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在早上呼吸新鲜空气。
words.en: Fresh air refers to air that is clean and not polluted, often considered beneficial for health.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 在……前部（指某物体内部的前端位置）
words.ex: The teacher stands in the front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在教室前面。
words.en: At the foremost part or position of something.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪头发；理发
words.ex: He has his hair cut every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都剪一次头发。
words.en: To get a haircut; to have someone cut one's hair.

words.ex: Half of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 一半的学生通过了考试。
words.en: Half of is used to indicate that something is divided into two equal parts.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: 短语动词. 碰巧做某事
words.ex: I happened to see her at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 我碰巧在公交站看到了她。
words.en: To do something by chance or without planning.

words.ex: I hate doing homework on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌在周末做作业。

words.tr: v. 讨厌去做某事；不愿意做某事
words.ex: I hate to wake up early on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌在周末早起。
words.en: To feel strong aversion or reluctance to perform a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 保持健康；维持健康状态
words.ex: He eats vegetables and runs every day to keep healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃蔬菜并跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain good physical condition and well-being.

words.ex: I have never heard of that song before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前从未听说过那首歌。
words.en: To become aware of something through hearing about it from someone else.

words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.tr: 短语动词，情不自禁地做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I can't help laughing when I see that funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那只搞笑的猫时，我忍不住笑。
words.en: To be unable to stop oneself from doing something, often because it is irresistible or habitual.

words.ex: They will hold a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将召开会议。
words.en: To organize and conduct a formal gathering of people for discussion or decision-making.

words.ex: They are on holiday in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在西班牙度假。
words.en: If you are on holiday, you are spending a period of time away from work or school, usually in order to relax or travel.

words.ex: They take a holiday in summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们夏天放假。
words.en: To take time off from work or routine to relax or travel.

words.tr: phrase. 有点；稍微；有一点……的
words.ex: It was a little kind of boring, but okay.
words.ex_cn: 这有点无聊，但还好。

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.tr: phrase. 打， 捶， 敲; 挝
words.ex: He knock at the door every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: He knocks on the door before entering.
words.ex_cn: 他进入前敲门。
words.en: To strike a door with the knuckles, a hard object, etc., in order to attract attention or gain entry.

words.tr: phrase. 母语；本族语；第一语言
words.ex: She speaks her mother language at home.
words.ex_cn: 她在家里说她的母语。
words.en: The first language a person learns from birth, also known as a native language.

words.ex: The meeting will last for two hours.
words.ex_cn: 会议将持续两个小时。
words.en: To continue for a specific period of time.

words.ex: I learn a lesson from my failure.
words.ex_cn: 我从失败中吸取教训。

words.tr: phrase. 举起；抬起；鼓舞；使振奋
words.ex: He lift up the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手把箱子举起来。
words.en: to raise something or someone to a higher position or level

words.ex: The candles light up the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛点亮了房间。
words.en: To make something bright or to start to burn.

words.ex: He waits in line for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上排队等公交车。
words.en: To stand in a line and wait for one's turn.

words.tr: phrase. 插队；不按顺序加入行列
words.ex: He cut in line at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店插队。
words.en: To move ahead of others who are waiting in line, in a way that is considered rude or unfair.

words.ex: The park was named after a famous hero.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是以一位著名英雄的名字命名的。
words.en: If you name someone or something after another person or thing, you give them the same name as that person or thing.

words.ex: He speaks his native language at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家说他的本地话。
words.en: A native language is the first language that a person learns to speak when they are a baby, rather than a language learned at school or as an adult.

words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: You use neither...nor when you are talking about two or more things that are not true or that do not happen.
